Conversion of shares

Shareholders of CT Global Managed Portfolio Trust PLC (the “Company”) have the opportunity to convert their Income shares into Growth shares or their Growth shares into Income shares annually, subject to minimum conversion thresholds.
The Company announces that, with regard to the 2026 conversion opportunity, valid conversion notices were received in respect of the following shares (the “Converting Shares”):
-          249,732 Income shares; and
-          120,857 Growth shares.

In accordance with the Company's articles of association, the Converting Shares will be converted into the other share class by reference to the ratio of the relative underlying net asset values of the Income shares and Growth shares as at close of business on 11 November 2026.
The conversion ratios were:
-          for every Converting Share which is an Income share, holders are entitled to 0.3965295 Growth shares; and
-          for every Converting Share which is a Growth share, holders are entitled to 2.5218806 Income shares.
Accordingly, with effect from 8.00 a.m. on 19 November 2026 the above Converting Shares will be converted into the following shares (the “Resulting Shares”):
-          99,026 Growth shares; and
-          304,786 Income shares.
Shareholders’ entitlements on conversion are rounded down to the nearest whole number of shares. The Resulting Shares will rank pari passu with the existing shares of the relevant class.
The Resulting Shares have been allotted conditional only to admission to trading on the Main Market of the London Stock Exchange.

An application has been made by the Company to the London Stock Exchange for the Resulting Shares to be admitted to trading on the Main Market (‘Admission’). It is expected that Admission will occur and dealings will commence in such shares at 8.00 a.m. on 19 November 2026.
It is anticipated that certificates in respect of the Resulting Shares will be posted by 25 November 2026 and CREST accounts credited on 19 November 2026.
Total voting rights

Following Admission, the Company’s issued share capital will consist of 62,082,248 Income shares and 38,734,879 Growth shares, of which nil Income shares and 5,358,000 Growth shares are held in treasury.

Therefore the total number of shares with voting rights in the Company is 62,082,248 Income shares and 33,376,879 Growth shares. These figures may be used by shareholders as the denominator for the calculations by which they will determine if they are required to notify their interest in, or a change to their interest in, the Company under the FCA's Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules.
Notes:

The nominal value of the shares following the conversion will be £0.042335806 per Income share and £0.042335806 per Growth share.  The change in nominal value is required for legal purposes and does not impact the net asset value of the shares.
The ISIN of the Income shares is GB00B2PP3J36
The ISIN of the Growth shares is GB00B2PP2527
